source: Key set: meshcentral-fork-ssot/evidence/live/summary.txt, section 'config flags' (read-only inventory 2026-10-27). Values marked {"evidence": key} are read from evidence/live/config-extra-values.json (captured read-only). Secret and host values were never read; they are substituted (dup) or left out (omit) with the reason.

aliasPort.reason: production answers through Caddy on 443; the duplicate is reached directly on its own port

mongodb.reason: local MongoDB 7.0.31 on 127.0.0.1:27018 with a fresh app user

portBind.reason: production value not captured; the duplicate binds its --bind address (default 127.0.0.1)

mpsPortBind.reason: production value not captured; the duplicate binds its --bind address (default 127.0.0.1)

tlsOffload.reason: no Caddy in front; MeshCentral terminates TLS itself with its generated certificate

allowedorigin.reason: 4 production hostnames; the duplicate allows its own names

certurl.omit: production edge URL; there is no proxy in front of the duplicate

customFiles.reason: layout B drops the r0 canary entry (D16)

title.reason: the duplicate is labelled so it cannot be mistaken for production

url.omit: production identifier; MeshCentral derives the local url

duplicate_only_settings.mongoDbName: separate databases meshcentral_dupA and meshcentral_dupB on one mongod
duplicate_only_settings.mpsPort: layout B only (4434); layout A keeps the production default 4433
